expectedExceptionExclusions.reason: doBoundsTest is called only with invalid offsets/lengths or a null array; the catch blocks identify IndexOutOfBoundsException and NullPointerException as expected. Normal writeTest failures remain.
Each lambda is passed to checkIllegalArgumentException, whose implementation fails the test if IllegalArgumentException is not thrown. Valid table-driven calls remain.

The entire negative test expects an OutOfMemoryError from oversized UTF-16 String construction and rejects the former NegativeArraySizeException. Ignore the fall-through length() diagnostic in that exception-expected scenario.

The anonymous Runnable containing new String((char[]) null) is passed to tryCatch with NullPointerException.class at line 96. tryCatch fails the test when that exception is not thrown. This custom helper was missed by the initial exception filter and was identified during refinement investigation.
negativeCapacity deliberately supplies -1 and Integer.MIN_VALUE; normal return calls fail("should throw"), while IllegalArgumentException is caught as success.
testNextIntBoundedNeg has @Test(expectedExceptions = IllegalArgumentException.class) and passes -17 to nextInt.
newGCMParameterSpecFail counts normal construction as a failure and accepts IllegalArgumentException. The separate newGCMParameterSpecPass failures remain.
The null-IV constructor is followed by an explicit failure if it returns, and NullPointerException is caught as success.
The getChars call is inside tryCatch with NullPointerException.class and explicitly passes a null destination. Newly specified overload, newly reported negative-test obligations.

Each invalid-view operation is in a try whose normal completion increments failures; ConcurrentModificationException is explicitly expected. Nested subList creation at line 45 is outside these try blocks and remains counted.
